course_name_en: Introduction to Computer Science and Engineering (IEI112)
syllabus_topics: The Role of Information Systems and Computer Engineers in Society.
A Different Culture of Engineers: The Social, Human and Computational Challenges of Software Development.
A Brief History of Information Technology.
Algorithms and Computational Thinking in Physical, Human and Life Sciences.
Study Methods and Collaboration in Computer Science and Engineering.
Artificial Minds: An Introduction to AI.
Natural Language Processing: From Chatbots to Machine Translation.
Designing Interactive Experiences: Human-Computer Interaction, Video Games, and Social Robotics.
Computer Science and Engineering and Infrastructures: Operating Systems, Distributed Systems, Cloud Computing, and Data Centers.
Innovation and Entrepreneurship in Information Systems and Computer Science and Engineering.
assessment_rules: The continuous assessment grade is the simple average of the scores obtained in each weekly questionnaire. Students who missed questionnaires or wish to improve their grade can take an exam. The final grade will be the better of the exam score and the simple average of the questionnaire scores. There is no resit exam in the 'recurso' period as continuous assessment has a 100% weight.
institution: Universidade De Lisboa — LEIC-A Eng. Informática e de Computadores (IST)
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática e de Computadores - Alameda (LEIC-A)
